SECONDARY KPIs

Current-stock KPIs are from the latest Corro inventory snapshot. Monthly stock rotation is based on units, not purchase receipts. Sales figures can include older stock and are never automatically attributed to a newly received batch.

RECEIPT PERFORMANCE

From arrival to sell-through

One vendor, store and receipt date per row. Open a row for its SKU detail; scroll the table to see every column.

VendorUnits InCOGS ValueMarkupDate Received30 Days60 Days90 DaysCurrent StockReceived SKUs · latest import

≥50% strong 25–49% monitor <25% attention Illustrative thresholds · not approved targets
COGS Value is received units × documented receipt cost. Markup = (current retail price ÷ receipt cost − 1) × 100. Current Stock counts the last imported on-hand stock of the received SKUs (including earlier/later lots), not the unsold balance of this receipt. Sales allocation uses SKU FIFO with opening stock; physical lot sales are not independently traceable.
